sync.description: Play one playlist on several screens in perfect step: the same content side by side, or one picture spread over a video wall.
sync.notInPlanTitle: Multi-screen sync is not included in your plan
sync.notInPlanBody: Multi-screen sync and video walls are part of the Enterprise plan. Contact WallX to set them up.
sync.name: Name

modeHints.mirror: every screen shows the same content and changes at the same moment
modeHints.wall: one picture spread over a grid of screens

sync.playlistHint: While the group is on, its screens play this playlist instead of their schedules. Emergencies still take over.
sync.wallHint: Pick the screen in each position, as seen from the front. Use screens of the same size and orientation.
sync.fillWall: Put one screen in every position of the wall.
sync.deleted: “{{name}}” deleted; its screens are back on their own schedules.
sync.deleteBody: Its screens go back to their own schedules and are republished now.
sync.emptyBody: Group screens that stand together (shop windows, menu boards, video walls) so they play in step.
sync.note: Synced screens need player 0.16.0 or newer and a stable network. They agree on the time with WallX Play to within a few hundredths of a second; videos are kept in step continuously.
